meta.name: ultimate-browsing
meta.description: Escalation skill for blocked or hard-to-reach web access — load it when a normal browse/fetch is blocked (WAF, 403, Cloudflare, JS-only render, login-gated, or a platform a generic fetcher cannot read). Tiered router: TIER 1 insane-search (headless extraction + WAF bypass via curl_cffi TLS impersonation, yt-dlp, Jina Reader, public APIs, Playwright real-Chrome fallback); TIER 1.5 agent-reach (platform-native readers for Chinese and social platforms: Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Weibo, Bilibili, V2EX, WeChat, plus Twitter/Reddit/LinkedIn/GitHub); TIER 2 Chrome stealth (CloakBrowser stealth Chromium + agent-browser CDP for clicks, forms, screenshots, video, cookie login). Triggers: blocked site, bypass bot detection, cloudflare/WAF bypass, scrape, stealth browser, import cookies, fill form, screenshot, play youtube, xiaohongshu, douyin, weibo, bilibili, v2ex, wechat article, podcast transcript. NOT for simple searches (use web-search) or plain fetches (use webfetch).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 突破网站封锁,抓取难访问的网页与社交内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常遇到网站打不开或无法直接抓取的网页。
copy.tagline_en: Access blocked sites and scrape hard-to-reach web and social content.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often hit blocked or hard-to-fetch web pages.

howto.what: 装上后，普通浏览被拦时 Claude 会按三层依次升级：先后台自动抓取绕过封锁；遇到小红书、抖音、微博等平台改用专用接口；仍失败则开隐身浏览器模拟真人点击、填表、截图等操作。最终交付文字、字幕、截图等结果。
howto.when: 当普通浏览或抓取打不开网页（被 WAF/Cloudflare 拦截、报 403、需要登录等），或目标是小红书、抖音、微博等通用工具读不了的平台，或需要点击、填表、截图等页面操作时触发。简单搜索、普通抓取不要用它。

say.text: 这个网页被 Cloudflare 拦了，帮我把正文抓下来。
say.note: Claude 会先绕过拦截把正文提取出来。

say.text: 帮我读一下这篇小红书笔记的内容。
say.note: 走小红书专用通道读取，不用通用抓取。

say.text: 用隐身浏览器打开这个链接，点一下按钮再截图。
say.note: Claude 启动隐身浏览器完成点击和截图。

howto.what_en: When a normal fetch is blocked, Claude escalates through three tiers: headless extraction to bypass blocks; platform-native readers for Chinese/social sites; a stealth browser for clicks, forms, screenshots, etc. Delivers text, subtitles, screenshots, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a normal fetch is blocked (WAF, 403, login-gated), the target is a Chinese/social platform (Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Weibo, etc.), or clicks/forms/screenshots needed. Not for simple searches or plain fetches.

say_en.text: Fetch the article from this page; Cloudflare is blocking me.
say_en.note: Claude will bypass the block with headless extraction.

say_en.text: Read the content of this Xiaohongshu post.
Open this link in a stealth browser, click the button, then screenshot.
